self.text: I’m Greta, mid‑30s, born and raised in the U.S., and I love a good photo walk. I’m looking for a relaxed outing, so I’m all about a slow pace and plenty of time to enjoy the scenery. There are no gear debates on my end—just a camera and an eye for moments. I’m not interested in a post‑processing lesson today; I want to capture what I see in the moment. I’ll bring my Sony camera, which I’ve trusted for years, and I prefer we keep the focus on the landscape, not on taking portraits of each other. I’m usually free on weekday evenings, so let’s plan a walk after work. Outside of photography, I’m an avid birdwatcher, so I’ll be on the lookout for feathered friends along the trail. I enjoy the quiet rhythm of hiking with a camera, and I’m excited to share that experience with someone who appreciates a calm, mindful stroll through nature.
